The MagicPython and MagicRegExp grammars are test fixtures copied from the
Python language support bundled with VSCodium (version 10.0.0 of its built-in
Python extension). They originate at https://github.com/MagicStack/MagicPython
and are distributed under the MIT license in LICENSE-MagicPython.

The extension uses the editor's built-in `source.python` grammar at runtime;
these fixtures are excluded from the VSIX.
